newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline up on crude gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline up on crude gains.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday.
Gasoline firmed $1 a tonne on Monday morning, tracking higher crude oil. Antwerp barges traded at $184.50 fob, while running Rotterdam refinery product talked $188.
Gas oil tracked stronger crude values in early talk but a weaker mark kept key German buyers sidelined.
Prompt Rotterdam heating oil was valued around IPE July flat, a shade softer than on Friday, but bids and offers were around $1 apart and there was little sign of demand improving in the short term.
